translation.name: Biblica® Ochiw Thuolo Motingʼo Loko Manyien™

content.text: Jehova Nyasaye wacho niya,
“Ubiro neno malit, un nyithindo ma wigi tek,
un jogo mosieko gi riekni ma ok maga,
ka uloso riwruok ka ok owuok e dwond Roho mara,
kendo ka ubiwo richo ewi richo;
uringo kudhi Misri ka ok upenja,
umanyo kony kuom Farao mondo oresu,
kendo ugengʼoru e tipo mar Misri kaka karu mar pondo.
To gengʼruok mawuok kuom Farao nobednu wichkuot,
kendo tipo mar Misri nokelnu masira.
Kata obedo ni gin gi jotelo Zoan
kendo jootene osechopo Hanes,
to ji duto noyud wichkuot
kuom jogo ma ok nyal konyogi,
jogo ma ok nyal konyogi kata kelonegi ber
to mana wichkuot kod achaya.”

content: Ma e wach mane okor kuom le mag Negev:

content.text: Kokadho e piny mar chandruok kod masira,
motingʼo sibuoche machwo to gi mamon
bende kama thuonde mag bungu kod thuonde maringo piyo odakie,
jootegi tingʼo mwandugi e ngʼe
punde kendo girkeni mag-gi otingʼ e kuom ngamia,
kiterone oganda maonge ohala,
ma en Misri, ma kony mare onge tiende.
Kuom mano iluonge ni Rahab maonge nyalo.
Dhiyo sani kendo indiknegi wach e kidi mopa,
Ndike e kitabu, mondo omi obed janeno,
manyaka chiengʼ e ndalo mabiro.
Magi gin oganda mongʼanyo nyithindo ma jo-miriambo,
ma ok oikore winjo puonj Jehova Nyasaye.
Giwachone jokor wach ni,
“Kik une fweny moro amora kendo!”
To ne jonabi,
“Kik uchak unyiswa fweny moro amora makare!”
Kornwauru mana weche mamorowa mag wuondruok.
Weuru yorni, wuoguru e ndarani
kendo we bwogowa gi Jal Maler mar Israel.

content: Kuom mano, ma e wach ma Jal Maler mar Israel wacho:

content.text: “Nikech isedagi winjo oteni,
mi iserwako chuny mar sando ji kendo iseyiengori e timbe mag miganga,
richoni nobini kaka ohinga mabor mobarore,
matetni kendo ruombore piny matek dichiel.
Obiro ngʼinjore matindo tindo mana
ka agulu molwar piny motore,
ma ok nyal yud kata dire moro kodongʼ
minyalo kwanygo mach e dwol kata pate mitwomogo pi.”

content: Ma e gima Jehova Nyasaye Manyalo Gik Moko Duto, Jal Maler mar Israel wacho:

content.text: “Warruok gi kwe nowuog kuom hulo richo,
tekou nowuog kuom horuok kod genou kuoma,
to kata onge gima usetimo kuom gigi duto.
Kata kamano uwacho ni,
‘Ooyo, wabiro idho farese mondo waringi.’
To mano ber ubiro ringo!
Bende nuwacho ni,
‘Wabiro idho faresewa mi waringi.’
Kuom mano joma lawou nobed jongʼwech molony.
Jou alufu achiel noringi
ka ngʼato achiel obwogogi;
bende jou noring duto ka ji abich obwogogi,
mi unudongʼ kar kendu,
mana ka yiend bandera mochwo ewi got malo
kata ka law bandera mafwadhore ewi got.”
Kata kamano pod odwaro nyiso
ngʼwono mare kuome; obiro mondo onyisu kech mare.
Nimar Jehova Nyasaye en Nyasaye ma ja-adiera.
Jogo duto mogeno kuome ogwedhi.

content: Yaye un oganda mag Sayun, modak Jerusalem, ok unuchak uywag kendo. Mano kaka notimnu ngʼwono e kinde ma unuywagne mondo okonyu! E sa moro amora mowinjo ywaku, to nokonyu.
Kata Jehova Nyasaye miyou chiemo mar chandruok kod pi mar masira, to jopuonju ok nochak opondnu kendo, to ununegi gi wengeu uwegi.
Kata ka ubaro korachwich kata koracham, itu to nowinj dwol mawuok ka ngʼeu, kawacho niya, “Ma e yo; luweuru.”
Bangʼe unudwany nyisecheu manono mubawo gi fedha kod dhahabu; kendo unuwitgi ka ukwano gi ka gik ma ok ler, mi uwitgi ka nanga moywego remb nyodo, kuwachonegi niya, “Aiuru ira.”
Bende noornu koth kuom kodhi muchwowo e lowo kendo chiemo mawuok e piny nobed mamiyo kendo mangʼeny. E kindeno jambu nokwa e lege madongo.
Rwethu kod pundeu mapuro lowo nocham lumb ogada kod chiembgi moregi, mi keyo gi uma kod opawo.
E odiechiengʼ maduongʼ mar yengʼo, ka kuonde ngʼicho motingʼore gi malo opodho, oula mag pige nomol ewi gode duto kod pidhe duto motingʼore malo.

Dwe norieny ka wangʼ chiengʼ, kendo ler mar chiengʼ nobed maler moloyo kaka orieny pile nyadibiriyo, machal mana gi ler mar chiengʼ mar ndalo abiriyo, e kindeno ma Jehova Nyasaye nowir kuonde duto moriemo mag joge kendo nochang adhondegi.

content.text: Ne, Nying Jehova Nyasaye aa kuma bor,
ka en-gi mirima mager machalo gi iro mopongʼo bor polo;
dhoge opongʼ gi mirima mangʼeny,
kendo lewe en mach mawengʼo.
Muche chalo gi oula mopongʼ,
mopongʼ nyaka dwonde.
Oyiengo ogendini gi rapiedhi mar kethruok;
kendo oywayo ji gi chuma mamiyo girwenyo.
Kendo unuwer wende machalo gi wende mag nyasi
mag sawo maler miwero gotieno;
chunyu nobed gi mor mana ka ji mabedo gi mor
ka goyo asili kadhi e got Jehova Nyasaye,
ma en Lwanda mar Israel.
Jehova Nyasaye nomi oganda winj dwonde mar duongʼ
kendo enomi gine lwete kabiro piny,
gi mirima mager kod mach mawengʼo,
bende gi rumbi motwere gi polo mariadore kod pe.
Dwond Jehova Nyasaye biro mako dho jo-Asuria;
to gi odungane obiro negogi.
Chwat ka chwat ma Jehova Nyasaye nochwadgigo
gi ludhe mar kum kokedo kodgi malit,
nomi jo-Nyasaye bed mamor
ka gigoyo oyieke kod nyatiti.
Tofeth noseiki nyaka aa chon;
noseik ne ruoth.
Kare mar kendo osekuny matut kendo malach,
kodhurie yiende mangʼeny gi mach maduongʼ;
kendo much Jehova Nyasaye,
machalo mach makakni ema moke.
